data.summary:
* Added `isWorktreeRegistered` + `repairWorktree` to `WorktreeManager` and wired them into `TaskDispatcher.adoptTask` so an orchestrator restart that drops `.git/worktrees/<taskId>/` metadata repairs it via `git worktree repair` before the new container starts.
  * When repair fails, `adoptTask` finalizes the task with a new terminal error code `WORKTREE_LOST` (remediation `contact_support`), skipping doomed attempts 2/3 instead of silently burning them.
  * Wired `WORKTREE_LOST` into `apps/code-agent/.../classifyFailure` as `fail`, placed above the orchestrator-remediation fallback so a stray `retry` hint can't resurrect a permanently-broken task.
  * Post-repair `symbolic-ref HEAD` diagnostic surfaces the latent "repair succeeded but branch ref lost → detached HEAD" case with a warn log.
  * 15260 tests pass, full `pnpm run ci:tracked` green, PR #1907 open.
